Container.Name: MoneyThistle
Container.Overview:
MoneyThistle: a simple personal money manager for a household, opened in your browser. Accounts and registers, Bills & Deposits, paychecks and paystubs, budgets, reports and a year-end tax report, and automatic backups to a folder and to Nextcloud / WebDAV. No bank connections. English, French, Spanish and Portuguese.
After Apply, open the WebUI: the first visit creates the administrator's sign-in. Everything else (people, Nextcloud backups, notifications, language) is set up in the app.
Updates: with the Repository ending in :latest, the Docker tab shows "update ready" for each new release. To stay on one version, change :latest to a version number, like :1.0.3.
Keep it on your home network or Tailscale: never open it to the public internet.
Container.DonateText: MoneyThistle is free and open source. If it helps, you can buy me a coffee.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web page (http://SERVER:PORT, also over Tailscale).

Config.Name: Money data
Config.Description: Your money file and settings. To pick another folder: empty this box first, then click it (Unraid's folder browser can't open a folder that doesn't exist yet; it's made on Apply).

Config.Name: Backups folder
Config.Description: Local backup copies (can be a share, e.g. /mnt/user/backups/moneythistle). To pick another folder: empty this box first, then click it (Unraid's folder browser can't open a folder that doesn't exist yet; it's made on Apply).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for 'today' (bills due, budget month). A name like America/Chicago or Europe/Berlin.
